create_VABase_dataset: create a VABase PyTorch dataset instance with data path, filenames, height, width, frame indexes, and num scales
use_pil_loader: use the pil_loader function to load an image file from a path and convert it to RGB
preprocess_color_images: preprocess color images by resizing to multiple scales and applying color augmentation using VABase preprocess method
get_item_from_dataset: get a single training item dictionary with color images, camera intrinsics, and depth ground truth from VABase
implement_get_color_subclass: implement the get_color abstract method in a VABase subclass to load color images from disk
